data.domain: Service Area Map and Project Record feature boundaries

data.summary: On the uncommitted feature tree from origin/main 2566c3524b78c54c894e6da4c59225a7350888c6, move only Service Area Map and Project Record behind src/features/. Keep each constant, node contract, annotation types, ordered field array, and renderer markup and CSS unchanged. Point Service Area Map at its contract and portable text. Point Project Record at its contract and src/shared/links.ts instead of the package root. Preserve the package root and Astro facades, the media picker, safe-link behavior, named slots, public classes, data hooks, theme tokens, CSS, the dinkus-blocks layer, EmDash 0.35, and the nine earlier pilots. Update FEATURE_MAP.md, the architecture allowlist and eleven-pilot assertion, the pack required paths, the public facades, the theming paths, and local proof. Verify a boundary diff, quick checks, focused Chromium for both blocks with inspected screenshots, and the full verifier. Exclude schema, copy, visual, or accessibility changes, media uploads, a new link policy, shared-utility work, dependency changes, commit, push, pull request, proof publication, merge, and deploy.

alternatives: Leave the working tree uncommitted for inspection.
data.reason: Every block now lives in src/features/. The full verifier passed. Commit and a pull request were not part of this move.
data.recommended: Commit the eleven feature-local pilots and open a pull request.
